# 2.16.16 Textbox.Width

> Source: [MS-RDL] v20251031 — pages PDF 184–184.
> Extraction textuelle : les tableaux complexes et diagrammes vectoriels peuvent nécessiter le PDF source.

2.16.16
Textbox.Width
The Textbox.Width element specifies the width of a Textbox. This element is optional. If this element
is present, its value MUST be an RdlSize. If the Textbox.Width element is not present, its value is
interpreted as the width of the text box's container, such as Rectangle or Body, minus the value of the
Textbox.Left element, if specified.
Following is the parent element of the Textbox.Width element.
Parent elements
Textbox
The following is the XML Schema definition of the Textbox.Width element.
 <xsd:element name="Width" type="SizeType" minOccurs="0" />
